knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Injectables are excluded from the mobile beauty course by team decision. The therapist declines on scope grounds and records the decision.
The Macedon Ranges classification is one council's position. Other councils must be checked.
WorkSafe Victoria names eyelash extension glue as a cyanoacrylate that may sensitise the skin and irritate the eyes.

practicalCriteria: Assessor presents a simulated request for an injectable treatment and observes the candidate decline on scope grounds and record the decision
Assessor checks that the candidate can state the state or council position for two services on the approved list, with the source
Assessor observes the candidate identify the hazard in a named product (eyelash glue, nail dip powder or chemical peel) and state the control from the safety data sheet
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of the declined request, with the reason and date
Written scope check for two services, with source and date
Safety data sheet for the named product, with the control identified
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate offers or begins an injectable treatment
The candidate offers a chemical peel without a reviewed scope decision
The candidate uses a product with no safety data sheet on hand
